scope: Generic journal-import audit methods and twenty-year capacity requirements. No private corpus content, source filenames, case identifiers, private-derived hashes or case findings in Git. No runtime, deployment or stable changes.
parent_outcome: Make large journal imports and key-pattern findings auditable without requiring the owner to read the entire source; support eventual twenty-year archives.
remaining_execution_gap: Production import, full-source semantic extraction, independent evaluation and cold-profile retrieval are not completed by method design.
